In the Data For Good generative AI white paper, BLOOM's estimated training carbon footprint initially was calculated at 30 tonnes CO2eq. When extending the scope to include additional factors such as the consumption of other data center equipment (increasing energy consumption from 433 MWh to 690 MWh), and removing the PUE factor, the impact rose to 39.3 tonnes CO2eq. Further including the carbon footprint from the manufacturing of servers and GPUs increased the estimate to 50.5 tonnes CO2eq. Finally, when adding the phase of model development (tests, evaluations, corrections), which adds 73.32 tonnes CO2eq, the total full-scope estimated carbon footprint for BLOOM's training reached 123.82 tonnes CO2eq. 

Thus, BLOOM's estimated training carbon footprint increased from the initial 30 tonnes CO2eq to a full-scope estimate of 123.82 tonnes CO2eq, which is about four times higher than the initial calculation.
